reason: A Telegram integration that provides an allowlisted mobile chat entry point to DeepSeek Harness, preserving per-chat sessions and returning agent responses through Telegram.

summaries.zh: 通过 Telegram Bot API 将授权私聊消息转发给 DeepSeek Harness Agent，并将回答返回 Telegram，同时保留会话上下文。
summaries.en: Connects allowlisted Telegram private chats to a DeepSeek Harness Agent and returns responses while preserving per-chat conversation context.

capabilities: Receives private Telegram messages through the Telegram Bot API
Forwards allowlisted messages to a DeepSeek Harness Agent that may use configured models and tools
Persists Telegram session context and update offsets
Sends agent responses back to Telegram chats
